tools.name: get_physical_presence
tools.description: Look up a business's Physical Presence Score (PPS) and first/last observation dates in a city. Returns the best-matching entity, score components, cohort percentile, and coverage confidence.

tools.name: compare_presence
tools.description: Compare the physical presence of multiple businesses in the same city, side by side, ranked by Physical Presence Score.

tools.name: city_index
tools.description: Complete snapshot-bound StreetProof PBI records for a city. Follow next_cursor until has_more is false; every page remains fixed to one snapshot. Optionally filter by industry, ranking state, or claim status. Rankings must be interpreted with coverage confidence. Aggregate statistics licensed CC BY

tools.name: check_physical_evidence
tools.description: Check whether StreetProof has accepted physical citations associated with a business in a city. This is not a legal-existence, licensing, quality, or address-ownership check. No accepted StreetProof citation matched the request. It never proves absence, closure, inactivity, or that a business is unr

tools.name: check_business_reality
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for check_physical_evidence. Removal is scheduled for 2026-10-27. The legacy input name is retained, but this is not a legal-existence or address check.

tools.name: get_pulse
tools.description: StreetPulse change events for a city since a date: new public records, newly observed assets, wrapped fleet assets, and stale assets. Closure, rebrand, and vacancy events remain explicitly unavailable until reviewed lifecycle evidence exists.
